t: A landscape LoRa pager with a keyboard, color screen, GPS, NFC and speaker.
steps: Buy the T-Lora Pager from the LilyGO store or Rokland. Pick the radio band for your country.
Unfold the antenna before you send any messages.
Charge it with a USB-C cable.
Load Meshtastic or MeshCore on it. Pre-flashed units are sometimes on sale too.
Set your name and region with the keyboard.
Send a test message to a friend with a second node.
To write your own code, install the Arduino IDE and pick the official lilygo_tlora_pager board.
Install LilyGoLib and try its factory example first.
meta: Open Board. From $80.96. A few stores.
